entries.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
entries.summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code.

entries.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
entries.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

entries.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
entries.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own.

entries.title: KMed-31B Technical Report
entries.summary: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another.
entries.why: 19 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CL

entries.title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?

entries.title: Working with AI
entries.summary: We interviewed people at 58 companies that use Claude about how AI is changing their work. They described few layoffs but reduced hiring, and said the most valuable uses of AI often involved reorganizing roles and workplaces around it.

entries.title: Migrating our Messages API to Rust
